info.name: Tagged Backup
info.summary: Back up files and folders carrying a system tag to S3, Google Drive or OneDrive
info.description:
Tagged Backup finds every file and folder that carries one of a set of collaborative (system) tags, packs them into a tar archive with a JSON manifest (paths, sizes, modification times, SHA-256 checksums, tags), optionally compresses it (gzip or bzip2) and encrypts it with [age](https://age-encryption.org) public keys, and uploads the result to an S3 compatible bucket, Google Drive or Microsoft OneDrive.
Backups run on a schedule via Nextcloud background jobs, on demand from the admin settings page, or with `occ tagged-backup:run`. Old backups can be pruned automatically.
info.author: Jason Williams
